reader_summary.headline: Today's episode is a true hedge fund master class.
reader_summary.overview: Today's episode is a true hedge fund master class. We convened a panel of three longstanding investors in the space - Craig Bergstrom, CIO and a Managing Partner of Corbin Capital Partners, Adam Blitz. All three have been in the space the better part of two decades and have both a wealth of experience and nuanced understanding to share.

key_points.text: We convened a panel of three longstanding investors in the space - Craig Bergstrom, CIO and a Managing Partner of Corbin Capital Partners, Adam Blitz.
Our conversation covers their respective investment approaches, impact of the higher rate environment, managing liquidity, and the potential for contagion.
From there, we canvass perspectives on platform hedge funds, long-short equity, credit, and macro strategies.
